entries.columnsContract: `product_fact_id FK, ordinal, source_basis_kind(decision_evidence|metadata_observation|western_analysis|western_match), work_id FK, attempt_id FK, plan_id FK, event_id FK, result_id FK, capability_ref, result_schema_ref, result_digest, source_ref, source_order, evidence_id NULL, evidence_digest NULL, input_binding_digest, reference_digest`
entries.constraintsContract: `PK(product_fact_id,ordinal)`、`UNIQUE(product_fact_id,result_id)`；ordinal从0连续且恰等于Fact row的`source_ref_count`，`source_order=ordinal`，全部Work/Attempt/Plan/Event必须构成同一Run、同一Execution Basis；`result_schema_ref`逐字节复制对应Capability manifest的result contract ref（该contract必须以`$ref`唯一指向下述领域typed Result），领域payload自己的`schemaRef`再独立逐字节校验；所有`result_digest`都逐字节复制对应`fx_event_result_bindings.result_digest=SHA-256(JCS(包含领域内digest字段的完整typed Result))`，不得复制Result内部排除自身计算的领域摘要；`input_binding_digest=SHA-256(JCS(fx_plan_nodes.input_bindings_json解析后的完整typed value))`。`decision_evidence`恰包含Product Identity Event的Decision Evidence实际引用的有界Query Result链；Movie/Series固定为一项`libra.product_identity.evidence.observe@1 → ProductIdentityEvidenceObservation@1`且只接受唯一resolved Provider identity；Series须同时命中Plan Owner binding冻结的Season、Run Episode claims的season_claim_digest、完整Observation/identity digest与provider_season_identity Evidence，不允许Related claim直接发布Fact，`source_ref`固定为Decision Evidence ID，Evidence列复制该Observation的Evidence ID/payload digest，且Query Result、Decision Evidence、Resolved Identity、Source Basis和同Run Subject必须一致；`libra.product_identity.resolve@1`在同一`domain_fact_commit` Event内原子形成Resolved Identity、Subject identity revision、Product Fact、Source refs、Result与marker，不允许先发布无Owner Fact的游离Resolution Result；`metadata_observation`固定`libra.product_metadata.fetch@1 → MetadataObservation@1`，`source_ref=MetadataObservation.sourceRef`，按`sourcePriority,evidence_id`排序且Evidence列非NULL；`western_analysis`固定一至16项`libra.western.analysis.observe@1 → WesternAnalysisResult@1`后恰一项`libra.western.metadata.normalize@1 → ProductMetadataDraft@1`，observe的`source_ref=WesternAnalysisResult.resultArtifactHandle.artifactHandleId`且该Handle/digest逐字节命中同Run Artifact Registry row，Evidence列非NULL；normalize的`source_ref=WesternAnalysisVariant.variantId`且Evidence列全NULL；normalize Plan input必须显式引用前序Result且最后Result逐字节等于Commit Draft；`western_match`恰一项`shared.face.reference.match@1 → PersonMatchEvidence@1`且`source_ref=PersonMatchEvidence.evidenceId`、Evidence列非NULL，其matches可为空但必须来自真实Frame→Embedding→Cluster→Match链。`reference_digest=SHA-256(JCS({schema:"libra.product-fact-source-ref@1",productFactId,ordinal,sourceBasisKind,workId,attemptId,planId,eventId,resultId,capabilityRef,resultSchemaRef,resultDigest,sourceRef,sourceOrder,evidenceId,evidenceDigest,inputBindingDigest}))`；relation存在期间所指Foundation链及Western Artifact Registry row不得GC；不得用later current Result替换历史引用

entries.constraintsContract: `on_deck_package_id=SHA-256(JCS({schema:"libra.on-deck-package-id@1",libraRunId,packageRevision}))`，只作为由Run内唯一revision预派生的稳定身份；`package_digest`必须由完整`OnDeckProductPackage@1`按8.6.19公式重建，不能使用自选字段子集；`published_at_ms`是commit metadata且不进入该content digest；`offer_id=SHA-256(JCS({schema:"libra.product-offer-id@1",onDeckPackageId,packageDigest}))`且唯一；run state pair逐字节引用immutable Run revision；四个manifest ID按8.6.21由run/package revision和manifest kind唯一派生；`related_disposition_set_digest`必须从Off-load Context逐项source-to-final mapping重建并精确覆盖Run Basis的Related Disposition Scope；任何遗漏、重复或role不一致禁止Promotion；`production_provenance_json`完整≤`1 MiB`（含8.6.19的两个Acceptance Snapshot及逐Primary读取集合），其他typed JSON各≤`64 KiB`；`promotion_decision_digest`与Run/Workspace/Control/derived authority historical rows重建值逐字节一致；`UNIQUE(libra_run_id,package_revision)`及`UNIQUE(libra_run_id,package_digest)`；Package row append-only，accepted/rejected终态只由`libra_delivery_receipts`表达；`INDEX(shelf_id,state,published_at_ms)`

entries.constraintsContract: `PK(on_deck_package_id,ordinal)`及`UNIQUE(on_deck_package_id,material_key)`；Workspace Handle JSON≤`16 KiB`；一个Physical Material在同一Product Manifest只有一个业务role，ordinal从0连续且至少一个primary，只有primary允许Episode relation；primary assert固定命中Run Input且Control pair非NULL；related assert固定命中同Run frozen Related Binding/Reference，source ref与derived authority非NULL而Control pair全NULL；Workspace acquire固定命中current Product Staging Reference并取得Libra Product Control。三种variant严格互斥；direct input使用bounded fingerprint，Workspace output使用写入流Artifact digest；member/set digest按8.6.21唯一公式

`PK(on_deck_package_id,member_ordinal,episode_key)`并复合FK到Product member；只允许season primary payload；每个Material允许0..32个Episode，按episodeKey UTF-8 bytes排序；完整relation与`episode_claim_set_digest`必须按8.6.21逐字节重建，禁止只保存摘要或回读Run current scope补齐
